reading.body:
All five resources in this library are free to use, though their licensing differs enough to matter for anyone reusing the material, from Distill's CC-BY articles to Wikimedia Commons images that carry per-file licenses rather than one blanket terms.

Two of the five focus specifically on explaining the transformer architecture, Jay Alammar's Illustrated Transformer and Georgia Tech's live, browser-based Transformer Explainer, which is a narrower concentration than the library's general description suggests and reflects how central that one architecture has become to how the field teaches itself. Distill.pub is notable for being archived rather than actively publishing, meaning it is a fixed historical resource rather than a growing one, while ML Visuals and Wikimedia Commons are described as open, editable collections that a reader could contribute to.

The data does not say how current these resources are relative to newer architectures beyond the transformer, such as the diffusion models covered elsewhere on this site, only what each resource covers and how it is licensed.
